content:
Young people in Nuevo Laredo who run a business — or want to start one — will get free help growing it this month, as the city's youth institute offers a two-session entrepreneurship workshop, according to the Oficina de Corresponsales news agency.

The Taller de Emprendimiento Joven, offered by the Instituto Municipal para el Desarrollo de la Juventud (IMJUVE), takes place Nov. 16 and 23, from 11 a.m. to noon, at the institute's offices on Privada Paseo Colón #5710 in Nuevo Laredo.

During the two sessions, participants will learn strategies for promoting their businesses on social media, along with tools to improve how their products look and how to stand out at bazaars and other sales spaces.

Spots are limited, and advance registration is required through the institute's online form at https://forms.gle/cAX116nuShidL7k18.

The institute says the workshop is part of the municipal government's effort to give young people training that strengthens their projects and opens up new opportunities to start a business.

Source: Oficina de Corresponsales, Nov. 5, 2026.
